title: Campus Daydream
prompt: Sweet, warm instrumental acoustic lo-fi at 78 BPM in a bright major key, with a tender felt-piano melody, soft fingerpicked nylon guitar, delicate glockenspiel accents, round mellow bass and very light brushed percussion. Cozy, wistful and gently hopeful, with a clear uncluttered mix, restrained dynamics and no vocals, spoken words, harsh drums or dramatic crescendos. Keep the arrangement calm and consistent for relaxed background listening, with a soft opening and an ending that returns to the opening harmony for comfortable repeat listening.
